label: Theme
description: Colors for the desktop, terminals, and supported apps.
effects: Rewrites theme files for the shell, terminals, and supported apps.
Runs any theme hooks you have installed.

label: Background
description: The image or video behind your windows, from the current theme's collection.

label: Icon pack
description: Icons for apps, folders, and files, in apps and in Omarchy's launcher and dock.
restart: Open apps may need reopening to show the new icons.
effects: Changes the icon theme in GSettings, which GTK and Qt apps read.
Names the same pack in the GTK settings.ini files and kdeglobals, creating them if needed, and in qt5ct and qt6ct where they exist.
Keeps your choice in omarchy-control/icons.json, so a theme change does not replace it.

label: Launcher and dock icons
description: Show your icon pack in Omarchy's launcher, dock, and app grid. Without this they mix icons from every installed pack.
effects: Keeps one icon per app, taken from your pack, in ~/.icons/omarchy-control, where Omarchy's launcher looks first.
Turning this off removes that folder. Your pack and your apps are not changed.

label: Font
description: The monospace font used across the desktop and terminals.
restart: Restarts the Omarchy shell. Open Ghostty and Foot windows need reopening.
effects: Updates terminal configs and fontconfig.
Restarts the Omarchy shell.
Runs any font hooks you have installed.

label: Chinese, Japanese, and Korean glyphs
description: Which regional forms to prefer when a font covers these languages.

label: Text size
description: Scales text in the Omarchy shell, GTK apps, and terminals together.
restart: Already open GTK apps and terminals may need reopening.
effects: Changes the shell font size.
Changes the GTK text scaling factor.
Changes terminal font sizes.

label: Window corners
description: Follow the theme, or always use sharp or rounded corners.

label: Window transparency
description: How see-through windows are.

label: Window gaps
description: Space between windows.

label: Square single window
description: Keeps a lone window from stretching across a wide screen.
sources: omarchy hyprland window single square aspect toggle

label: Animations and blur
description: Turn off to reduce motion, or on machines without a capable GPU.

label: Blur
description: Where see-through surfaces blur what is behind them.

label: Blur strength
description: How strongly what is behind is blurred.

label: Blur radius
description: How far each pass spreads.

label: Blur passes
description: More passes are smoother and blurrier, and cost more GPU time.

label: Blur brightness
description: How light the blurred background is.

label: Blur contrast
description: How far light and dark areas stand apart.

label: Color boost
description: Makes blurred colors richer.

label: Grain
description: Fine grain over the blur, which hides banding.

label: Blur menus and popups
description: Right-click menus and tooltips.

label: Blur behind the scratchpad
description: Costs more GPU time.

label: Floating windows show only the wallpaper
description: Cheaper. What is under a floating window is not blurred into it.

label: Boot screen theme
description: Which theme styles the boot and disk-unlock screen.

label: Show the bar
description: Hide or show the bar without restarting the shell.

label: Bar position
description: Which edge of the screen the bar sits on.

label: Bar background
description: Solid, blurred, or transparent.

label: Clock format
description: How the bar shows the date and time.

label: Clock format on a side bar
description: How a left or right bar stacks the time.

label: Dock position
description: Where the dock appears on floating workspaces.

label: Hide the dock automatically
description: The dock stays hidden until the pointer reaches its edge.

label: Default workspace layout
description: Used by workspaces without a layout of their own.

label: Silence notifications
description: Do not disturb: new notifications stay quiet until you turn this off.

label: Crash notifications
description: Tells you when a program crashes, with a route to diagnose it.

label: Mirror theme to Herdr machines
description: Keep the theme in step with machines you reach through Herdr.

label: Screen brightness
description: Brightness of the focused display.

read.unsupported: {target} has no brightness control Omarchy can reach: no backlight, and no answer over DDC/CI.

label: Scale of the focused display
description: Hyprland rounds to the nearest scale this mode can display exactly.
effects: Saves a rule for this monitor in monitors.lua.

label: Night light
description: A warmer screen color for the evening.
multiDescription: A warmer screen color across all displays.

label: Touchpad enabled
description: Turn the built-in touchpad on or off.

confirmWhen.false: Make sure you have another way to control the pointer before turning this off.

label: Touchscreen enabled
description: Turn touch input on or off.

label: Superwhisper mode
description: Offline modes need their models downloaded first, in Superwhisper's settings.
effects: Cloud mode sends your speech over the internet.

label: Dictation tone
description: How cleaned-up dictated text should sound.

label: Paste dictated text
description: Off copies it to the clipboard only.

label: DNS provider
description: Who answers name lookups for this computer.
effects: Changes system-wide NetworkManager settings.
You may be asked to authenticate.
confirmAlways: This changes DNS for the whole system and can briefly interrupt connections.

label: Wi-Fi band
description: Pin the active connection to a band, or let it choose.
confirmAlways: Changing the band reconnects Wi-Fi, which briefly interrupts your connection.

label: Power profile
description: Used now, and remembered for the current power source.

label: Profile on AC power
description: Remembered for when the computer is plugged in. Also becomes the active profile right now.

label: Profile on battery
description: Remembered for when the computer is unplugged. Also becomes the active profile right now.

label: Lock after
description: How long the computer sits idle before it locks.

label: Start screensaver after
description: How long the computer sits idle before the screensaver starts.

label: Stay awake
description: Skip the lock and screensaver timers until you turn this off.

label: Screensaver available
description: Turn off to go straight from idle to lock.

label: Show Suspend in the system menu
description: Whether the system menu offers Suspend.

label: Hibernation
description: Whether this computer is set up to hibernate.

label: Web browser
description: Opens web links. Only installed browsers are listed; install others below.

label: Terminal
description: Used by Super+Return and terminal apps. Only installed terminals are listed.

label: Text editor
description: Opens config files and text from Omarchy. Only installed editors are listed.

label: Coding agent
description: Choose one under AI agents below. Choosing one also starts it, and can install it first.

label: Dictation
description: Choose one under Input & accessibility. Choosing one opens its installer.

label: SSH server
description: Whether other computers can log in over SSH.

label: Firewall
description: Whether the UFW firewall service is running. Viewing its rules needs administrator access.

label: Update channel
description: Change it under Updates below.

label: Default kernel
description: The kernel Limine boots by default.

label: Language
description: The language of Omarchy and of apps opened from now on.
restart: Restarts the Omarchy shell. Apps already open keep their language until reopened.
effects: Sets the session locale for new apps.
You may be asked to authenticate to generate the locale.
Chinese, Japanese, and Korean can add an input method and glyph preference.

label: Time zone
description: Change it with the time zone picker below.

label: Automatic time sync
description: Whether the clock is synchronized over the network.

label: Weather location
description: Leave empty to detect it from your connection. Reading this setting never contacts a service.
